problem_statement: When the cold-chain policy service times out on a single lookup, `process_queue` raises `PolicyTimeout` and the whole release run aborts, so every request behind it in the queue is left unprocessed. This happens a few times a night when the policy service is under load. A timeout on one request should not take down the run: the run should finish cleanly and the remaining requests should still be processed. `tests/test_release_queue.py::test_policy_timeout_does_not_abort_the_run` reproduces the problem.
